_comment: It mirrors the policy of `licensee` in `mkdocs.kotlin-conventions`: everything shipped with the
plugin has to be Apache-2.0. Licensee matches SPDX identifiers, this plugin matches the licence
name as the POM declares it, so every spelling Apache-2.0 appears under is listed here.
A new entry MUST stay an Apache-2.0 spelling - another licence is a policy change.
